name: sfu-converter
description: Single-skill Codex plugin for Siberian Federal University (СФУ) academic documents. Routes document types, generates V2 TXT, lints, fixes, and converts to DOCX via the sfu-converter CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Generate SFU academic documents as V2 TXT and convert them to DOCX
interface.longDescription: Routes SFU lab reports, coursework, VKR, research, practice, and small written works through one Codex skill, then uses the sfu-converter CLI lint and convert loop.
defaultPrompt: Сделай лабораторную работу СФУ по теме
Оформи курсовую СФУ и сконвертируй в DOCX
